name: review-kit
description: The markdown review trio plus a folded-in dual-vault-sync engine. obsidian-versioned-review uses green additions, orange deletion proposals, purple questions, and red answers. qa-audit supports release QA, while dual-vault-sync reconciles a small tier 1 set between laptop and mobile iCloud Obsidian. Mobile pruning remains a dry run unless explicitly applied.
